typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Origin as string,
		{Reporting Date} as string,
		{Title (Title)} as string,
		Instrument as string,
		{First Notice Day} as string,
		Long as string,
		{Last Trade Date} as string,
		Short as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource sink(input(
		Origin as string,
		Reporting_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Title__Title_ as string,
		Instrument as string,
		First_Notice_Day as string,
		Long as double,
		Last_Trade_Date as string,
		Short as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Origin,
		Reporting_Date = {Reporting Date},
		Title__Title_ = {Title (Title)},
		Instrument,
		First_Notice_Day = {First Notice Day},
		Long,
		Last_Trade_Date = {Last Trade Date},
		Short),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
